# My MotoFolio

> Universal client-side vehicle maintenance tracker, periodic service interval calculator, workshop expense ledger, fuel economy logbook, and printable A4 inspection reports.

## Overview
- Website: [My MotoFolio](https://motofolio.pages.dev/)
- License: [MIT License](https://opensource.org/license/mit)
- Architecture: 100% Client-Side, Offline-First Progressive Web App (PWA) with browser LocalStorage and optional direct Google Drive sync.
- Privacy Model: Zero server databases, 100% private client-side storage.

## Key Capabilities & Automotive Calculations
- **Periodic Maintenance Schedule Engine**: Tracks engine oil, transmission fluid, spark plugs, brake pads, coolant, timing belts, tires, and filters with live remaining distance countdowns and overdue warnings (`Good`, `Due Soon` within 1,000 km, `Overdue`).
- **Interactive Odometer Simulation**: Fast increment (`+1k`, `+5k` km) and manual odometer calibration recalculating all component wear in real time.
- **Workshop Service Ledger**: Complete expense tracking with labor vs. parts cost breakdown, mechanic attribution, category filters, and keyword search.
- **Fuel Economy Logbook**: Fuel consumption calculator tracking liters, cost per km, mileage, fuel grade, and full tank status.
- **Bi-directional Data Interchange**: Import and export vehicles via clean CSV spreadsheets and full JSON v2.0 profiles.
- **Printable A4 Vehicle Condition Reports**: Instant professional inspection summaries ready for printing or exporting to PDF.

## Pages & Machine-Readable Docs
- [Main Dashboard](https://motofolio.pages.dev/): Interactive vehicle maintenance tracker and service interval calculator.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://motofolio.pages.dev/faqs): Comprehensive Q&A covering maintenance calculations, CSV/JSON interchange, and offline privacy.
- [FAQs Markdown](https://motofolio.pages.dev/faqs.md): Clean Markdown export of all FAQs for AI agents and LLMs.
- [FAQs JSON Data](https://motofolio.pages.dev/data/faqs.json): Structured JSON dataset of all FAQs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://motofolio.pages.dev/privacy-policy): Client-side storage and Google Drive OAuth privacy policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://motofolio.pages.dev/terms-of-service): Open-source MIT terms of use.
- [XML Sitemap](https://motofolio.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL index.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)](https://motofolio.pages.dev/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable capability and resource manifest.
